reports.title: Iran · Israel · US Desk — Morning Brief
reports.summary: The weekend crossed two lines flagged as the real tail triggers: the first US combat deaths from Iranian fire since March, and the energy-restraint keystone breaking on both sides.

reports.title: Daily Market Brief
reports.summary: Two-layer market: a structurally bearish supply base overlaid with a re-inflating geopolitical risk premium. Price is held up by the premium, not the fundamentals.

reports.title: Weekly Report — Oil & Gas Desk
reports.summary: This week's distillate build and modest crude draw are consistent with the floating-storage glut still washing through — not an accelerating global deficit. The ~5 mb/d clock is a post-July risk.
